description: A classical wave toy on a 2D disk: a decaying radial envelope times a helical spiral phase. Discrete modes are selected by a frozen closure gate (integer azimuthal number, integer number of spiral pitches across the disk radius), and a stated resolution rule measures how envelope decay changes the resolved closure set. Synthetic only; no claim about real atoms, real electromagnetism, or quantum mechanics. Standard library only.
title: spiral-envelope-atoms
